gh_bee25d48c1d08bdb89cd3956.title: [Sponsors] How sponsorship works here — current sponsors, hard limits, and how to propose a README CTA placement
gh_bee25d48c1d08bdb89cd3956.description:
**This is a standing, pinned issue. It is intentionally left open — please do not close it.** It is the single public place where sponsorship happens in the open: what we accept, what we refuse, what it costs us to run this, and how anyone can propose a placement.

If you just want to submit a proposal, skip to [How to propose a placement](#how-to-propose-a-placement).

---

## Why this repo takes sponsorship at all

This project is free, solo-maintained, and runs a scraper against 224+ company APIs **every 5 minutes, 24/7**. That has a real cost in infrastructure and in maintainer hours. There are three ways it stays alive: people who [sponsor the maintainer](https://github.com/sponsors/ambicuity), people who contribute fixes, and a small number of products that pay for a placement in this README.

We would rather be openly, boringly transparent about that third one than pretend it doesn't happen. **Every paid placement in this repository is labelled "Sponsored by …" in the README itself.** If you ever see a product promoted here without that label, that's a bug — please comment on this issue.

## Current sponsors

| Sponsor | What it is | Where it appears | Relationship |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[Tailr](https://www.tailr.uk)** | Rewrites your résumé per job posting and shows an ATS match score. Free 10/day, no card. | `README.md` sponsor section + a badge on the [job board](https://jobs.riteshrana.engineer/) | Sponsor. Disclosed: a sibling product cross-promoted by the maintainer, not an arm's-length ad buy. |
| **[Zapply](https://app.zapply.jobs)** | Chrome extension that autofills job applications, plus its own job board and application tracking. | `README.md` "Website & Autofill Extension" CTA only | Paid monthly CTA placement under a written agreement. Not affiliated with the maintainer. |

Sponsorship buys **README real estate and nothing else.**

## What sponsorship never buys

These are hard lines, not negotiating positions:

- **No influence over job data.** Listings, categories, rankings, sort order, and dedup behaviour are driven by [`config.yml`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/main/config.yml) and the scraper. A sponsor cannot buy a listing, buy a better position in a table, or get a competitor removed. Paying us does not get your company's roles surfaced.
- **No reader tracking.** No pixels, no analytics scripts, no third-party JS, no data about who read what. A plain link with a `?ref=` query parameter is the absolute maximum, and it is visible in the Markdown for anyone to inspect.
- **No editorial control.** Sponsors do not review, approve, or veto anything outside their own CTA block — not the README copy around it, not issues, not PRs, not moderation.
- **No implied endorsement of a hiring outcome.** We will not host copy that promises a job, an interview, a referral, or a salary.

## What we will not accept, at any price

- Guaranteed-job, guaranteed-interview, or guaranteed-salary claims ("we place you at FAANG").
- Pay-to-apply schemes, or anything that charges a job seeker to *submit* an application.
- Résumé mills, fake-experience services, or anything that coaches applicants to misrepresent themselves.
- Visa/immigration "guarantees", or products that prey on international students' status anxiety.
- Unpaid-internship marketplaces and training programmes that bill students for the privilege of working.
- MLM, crypto/trading pitches, and anything aimed at extracting money from people who are, by definition, currently unemployed.
- Anything requiring a database, a frontend framework, or an external orchestrator to be added to this repo — the [architectural constraints](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) apply to sponsors too.

New grads are a vulnerable audience with time pressure and little leverage. Our bar for what we'll put in front of them is deliberately higher than our need for the money.

## Where placements are allowed to live

- **`README.md` — yes.** This is the default and, for paid CTAs, currently the only place.
- **The [live job board](https://jobs.riteshrana.engineer/) — ad-free by default.** The site carries no paid CTA. Tailr's badge there predates this policy and is disclosed above; we are not adding more.
- **Job listings, `jobs.json`, the RSS feed, commit messages, releases — never.** These are data, not inventory.

## How to propose a placement

1. Open a proposal with the **[🤝 Sponsorship / CTA Placement Proposal](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/issues/new?template=sponsor_placement.yml)** template. Fill it in honestly — the checkboxes at the bottom are the rules above restated, and proposals that tick them falsely get closed and stay closed.
2. Expect a reply in **1–2 weeks**. This is a spare-time project; sponsorship enquiries do not jump the queue ahead of bug fixes.
3. If it's a fit, we agree terms **in writing, off this issue** (copy, destination URL, assets, disclosure wording, duration, fee, removal notice).
4. The placement lands as a normal reviewed **pull request** with the assets committed to this repo. Nothing goes live by side channel, and we never hotlink your CDN.
5. It's live when that PR is merged and CI is green — not when terms are agreed.

**Do not post pricing you consider confidential, contract terms, invoices, or payment details in this public issue or in a proposal issue.** Email `contact@riteshrana.engineer` for that. Public issues get indexed by search engines, quoted in replies, and picked up by archives and scrapers, so deleting a comment later does not unpublish what it said.

## For readers, contributors, and forks

- **Spotted a sponsor behaving badly?** If a sponsored product misleads job seekers, charges for something it advertised as free, or spams users who click through, comment here or open a bug report. We will ask them to fix it, and we will remove the placement if they don't. A placement is rented, not owned.
- **Reviewing a sponsorship PR?** Check three things: the "Sponsored by …" disclosure is present and adjacent to the CTA, assets are committed in-repo rather than hotlinked, and nothing outside the CTA block changed.
- **Forking this repo?** Sponsor placements are *ours*, not part of the project's licence. Please strip the Tailr and Zapply blocks from your fork's README — the [MIT licence](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/main/LICENSE) covers the code, not a sponsor's marks, and their agreements do not extend to you.
- **Want to support the project without a placement?** [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/ambicuity), [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/ritesh.rana), a star, or — best of all — a PR.

---

*Maintained per [GOVERNANCE.md](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md). Kept open on purpose as the permanent public record of how sponsorship works here.*
